summary: Retest of iteration_53 security follow-ups (SEC-004 hoisted traversal guard + rate limiter ip_agnostic=True). All 29 security + 38 marketplace regression = 67/67 tests pass. Both minor issues from iter_53 are now closed.
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-004: hoisted traversal guard in /app/backend/routes/misc.py::delete_upload correctly runs BEFORE the CLOUDINARY_ENABLED branch. Verified URL-encoded `..%2F..%2F..`, `..%5C..%5C..`, `foo%2F%2E%2E%2Fbar` and NULL-byte `foo%00.jpg` all return 400 (or 400-HTML from Cloudflare for NULL-byte before reaching backend). Raw `../../etc/passwd` is normalized away by requests-client/ingress per RFC 3986 and returns 404 before hitting the backend — still safe, no 200 possible.

P3-3: `ip_agnostic=True` on login-email + forgot-password-email + cloudinary-sign buckets all trip 429 at the expected attempt count in the preview env with ingress egress-IP rotation. Previous xfail on cloudinary-sign is now a hard PASS.

Legit-happy-path regression PASS: `/api/upload/myisraelrental/some-legit-public-id` (public_id with `/`, no `..`) returns 200 through cloudinary branch; local UUID.jpg upload+delete round-trip returns 200.

Nit — not a bug: `_hits` dict in utils/rate_limit.py grows unbounded across unique test-run keys. Fine for preview single-worker but a slow leak in long-lived processes. Optional: prune keys with empty deque every N inserts, or migrate to Redis with TTL.

Nit — SEC-004 message parity: NULL-byte on `foo%00.jpg` returns 400 from Cloudflare edge, not the FastAPI JSON 400. Backend guard also handles it if the byte ever slips past the edge (verified via code inspection). Consider adding a middleware `%00`-in-raw-path reject for consistency, but not required — Cloudflare is a hard block.
